changes.title: Run DNA fingerprints and comparisons
changes.text: Measure a run with defined combat, healing, equipment and exploration rates. Compare two fingerprints, retain unknown and inferred marks, and inspect the original run and recorded context events behind each metric.

changes.title: Luck laboratory with matched generation evidence
changes.text: Compare recorded generation outcomes against finished random-seed runs with matching class, rules, custom settings, version and progress. Inspect exact reference samples, exclusions and tie-aware empirical percentiles. Generation details require an explicit finished-run disclosure choice. This does not invent theoretical RNG odds or change scores.

changes.title: Automatic discoveries from sufficient recorded data
changes.text: Find exploratory win-rate contrasts between matched class or subclass groups with at least twenty exact outcomes each. Adjusted uncertainty bands, screened-comparison counts and both contributor groups remain inspectable. Insufficient data produces no invented discovery; association is not treated as causation.

changes.title: Statistical investigation lab
changes.text: Capture filtered populations A and B and compare numeric statistics or recorded win rates. Show exact sample sizes, exclusions, distributions and overlap; suppress inference when independence or matching requirements fail. Separately saved query snapshots retain their filters and rules with integrity checks, without altering saved views or history.

changes.title: Research evidence and exports
changes.text: Open Research lab from Home, a table or Options. Each analysis offers source records and exports its definitions, sample exclusions, limitations and evidence identities in existing report formats. Background analysis and restored menus reject changed contexts; unfinished hidden information remains protected.

changes.title: Four-capability regression and native acceptance
changes.text: Thirty-one core regressions cover schema-backed rates, uncertainty, matched peers, sample overlap, binary intervals, discovery screening, pin persistence and tamper protection, evidence navigation and reports. Four Android methods select every research capability with real pointer events, inspect contributors, exercise the finished-run disclosure choice and check restoration guards. All previous tests and captures remain required.

changes.title: Recorded evidence throughout the research lab
changes.text: I kept existing saves, saved views, recorded scores and in-game Changes history intact. These tools analyze recorded evidence, identify insufficient data and preserve unknowns. I have not added a luck-based score multiplier.
